verification.host: 5 focused tests passed; 51 JVM cases repeated across GC; ordinary, VM-generated and synthetic native-provider error propagation verified

trigger: Timer host DEX fixture constructing new IllegalStateException("timer task failed") exposed missing portable Throwable attachment; this was a shared Java runtime gap.
limitations: This is message-state compatibility, not full Throwable/cause/suppression/stacktrace support.
Specialized builtin constructors requiring additional state or specialized message behavior are rejected.
The host native-provider materialization test does not execute a native guest binary or Horizon thread.
No Candy Crush/Mekorama first-screen compatibility claim follows from these host results.

implementation.privacy: Valid DEX fields named message/detailMessage cannot alias the private slot; no exception side table or process-global state was added.
implementation.unsupported: Cause, suppression and stack APIs/constructors are explicit unavailable; constructors provide message-state semantics without a stack-capture compatibility claim.
implementation.exception_flow: Portable athrow reads the private message state. VM-generated and handler-materialized Throwable objects initialize that same slot. Legacy std state and behavior are unchanged.
implementation.state: Nullable String reference in private heap field java.lang.Throwable#detailMessage, charged by Heap.put_field and traced by ordinary heap GC.
implementation.constructors: Common implemented builtin default/String constructors; real DEX constructors are resolved normally and call their platform superclass constructor. Specialized constructor shapes remain API_UNAVAILABLE.
implementation.dispatch: getMessage reads the private slot. getLocalizedMessage invokes virtual getMessage. toString invokes virtual getLocalizedMessage and uses the exact binary class name. DEX overrides and invoke-super through DEX and platform ancestors are preserved.
implementation.metadata: AssertionError has its real Error ancestry so builtin default construction participates in the shared Throwable hierarchy.

iteration_note: Initial focused run passed 4 tests and found missing AssertionError hierarchy in the final oracle kind. Added that real ancestry and corrected exact descriptor-prefix handling; final run passed all five. The fixture uses a package beginning with L to verify binary-name preservation.
scope: Portable Throwable detail-message state and minimal constructors/message APIs

commands.command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo test -p as-switch-smoke --features host-cli,portable-tests --test portable_throwable --locked -- --nocapture
